scope: 30 AI dependency units, not 30 learning days

units.title: Baseline, scope and ownership
units.primary_task: Inspect the minimal starter; attempt a small Python transform and SQL query if a runtime is available, otherwise record the unavailable environment as a baseline finding; choose the smallest useful public/synthetic-document workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual attempts and unknowns without marking prior SWE experience as new curriculum completion.
Name one user, one workflow, a non-AI baseline, one measurable prototype objective and explicit non-goals.
Explain the intended starter request path from code; execution and an actual code-change check occur after the environment is available, not falsely before setup.
units.flex_task: Write the architecture sketch and own-vs-borrowed code note.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Reproducible environment and real-model feasibility
units.primary_task: Lock the Python project environment; create safe configuration; measure available CPU/RAM/disk; verify a no-service-fee real local generation and embedding route against official distribution/license information.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment runs a basic test and the starter request path; no key or private data is committed. Record a blocker rather than claiming execution if unavailable.
Record machine measurements, model/runtime candidates, download size/license and expected limitations; exact versions are resolved at implementation.
If inference cannot run within available hardware/permissions, record a blocker and the specific approval/access needed; no mock pass.
units.flex_task: Resolve setup or dependency problems; otherwise stop or revisit the baseline.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Python data contracts and tests
units.primary_task: Implement typed request/document records, a small plain-text/Markdown ingestion function and meaningful error handling; use tests rather than re-learning all programming basics. From the first read, constrain ingestion to the owned fixture directory; default raw-content logging off.
acceptance_criteria: Parse the permitted small fixture format and reject malformed/empty inputs.
Demonstrate one exception path and test one boundary case.
Make one small input-format change without copying a finished solution.
units.flex_task: Study only the Python typing, collection or exception gaps revealed by the task.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Small API with observable failure paths
units.primary_task: Implement /health and a document-metadata endpoint in one Python API stack; connect input validation, request IDs and structured errors. Bind to loopback only by default; enforce fixture-directory scope and keep raw-content logging off from the start.
acceptance_criteria: Success, invalid-input and not-found requests return the documented status/body.
A request ID connects response to a log entry without secrets.
Explain the request path and why this stack is sufficient; no framework collection.
Default API binding is loopback-only; a filename/path cannot escape the owned fixture directory, and raw document/prompt logging is off.
units.flex_task: Repair API/setup failures; avoid optional architecture expansion.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Understand inference and install a real runtime
units.primary_task: Learn token/context/output-limit basics and the difference between generation, embeddings and retrieval; install/configure the selected real local model runtime and a narrow provider adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Model identifier/revision, license, quantization, context and output limits are recorded where available.
Adapter accepts a prompt and exposes explicit timeout/error behavior; credentials, if ever authorized, remain outside code.
Explain why an extractive/template answer and a mocked provider are not generative inference.
units.flex_task: Use current official runtime/model documentation; do not memorize a stale model list.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: First real generated response
units.primary_task: Call the actual pretrained generative model through the adapter on three simple tasks; capture real outputs, elapsed time and failures; tune only output/context limits for the machine.
acceptance_criteria: At least one non-canned generated response is produced by the recorded real model, not a test double.
Record hardware, request settings, actual timing and actual token counts if exposed; otherwise mark counts unavailable.
A forced timeout/unavailable runtime is handled honestly; failed inference keeps the capability gate blocked.
units.flex_task: Repair runtime or adapter issues; request a bounded alternative only if local capability is insufficient.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Reality check and first evidence note
units.primary_task: Run a five-prompt capability smoke set including an impossible/unanswerable request; inspect failures and confirm what the model can and cannot support in this prototype.
acceptance_criteria: All five actual outcomes are saved, including failure or uncertainty.
Distinguish a plausible response from a verified answer.
Decide whether the local model is viable for the narrow corpus; do not hide a hardware/quality blocker.
units.flex_task: The evidence note is scheduled weekly in the daily schedule, not charged twice to this unit.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Real generation behind the API
units.primary_task: Implement a /generate request path using the real adapter with a bounded request deadline and client cancellation/error behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A real HTTP request returns actual model output.
Invalid input, timeout and unavailable provider paths are tested.
Separate deterministic mocked unit tests from the real-model integration receipt.
units.flex_task: Debug the integration; defer streaming until the basic path is reliable.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Thin React workflow
units.primary_task: Use existing React/TypeScript skills to build a minimal question/answer screen with loading, empty, cancel/error and result states; avoid visual-polish work unrelated to the workflow.
acceptance_criteria: The UI calls the real backend and shows a real generated answer.
A failed/canceled request cannot leave the UI falsely showing success.
Explain the frontend/backend contract and one accessible error-state choice.
units.flex_task: Fix integration or accessibility defects; no extra design system.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Structured output without trusting it
units.primary_task: Define an answer schema, validate actual model output, and implement one bounded repair/retry or explicit failure path; compare success and malformed output.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed or missing fields are rejected rather than silently coerced into a valid answer.
Retries are capped and observable; failure is still possible.
Explain that schema validity does not establish factual correctness.
units.flex_task: Review JSON/schema/validation behavior using the actual selected SDK or plain API.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Versioned small corpus and SQL metadata
units.primary_task: Create or use ten licensed public/synthetic Markdown/text documents (roughly 150–300 words each); persist IDs, source, content hash and version in SQLite with idempotent ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Reingesting unchanged input does not duplicate documents.
A changed document produces the intended version/update behavior.
Run and explain a SQL query that joins or aggregates document/ingestion metadata; record licensing/source.
units.flex_task: Repair schema/data bugs; keep PDF/OCR and private uploads out of month one.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Chunking with source provenance
units.primary_task: Implement a small deterministic chunker that preserves document/version/source offsets or headings; set a measured context-compatible chunk budget and test boundary behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Every chunk maps back to one source document/version and actual text.
Empty, very short and over-limit documents have tested behavior.
Explain the retrieval/context tradeoff; do not claim one chunk size is universally optimal.
units.flex_task: Study tokens versus characters and the effect of overlap using one concrete example.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Real embeddings and vector intuition
units.primary_task: Run an actual pretrained embedding model over chunks; validate dimensions/finite values and examine similarities on a few related/unrelated pairs.
acceptance_criteria: Vectors come from the real recorded model, not random/hash/mock embeddings.
Dimensions, normalization assumptions and model revision are recorded.
Explain dot product/cosine similarity and why similarity alone does not prove answerability.
units.flex_task: Work one small vector/similarity example by hand and check it in code.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Evaluation cases before retrieval tuning
units.primary_task: Create/review 30 small question cases with expected evidence and answerability labels; separate 20 development cases and 10 held-out cases before tuning.
acceptance_criteria: Development: 12 answerable, 4 unanswerable and 4 adversarial/instruction-conflict cases; held-out: 6 answerable, 2 unanswerable and 2 adversarial cases.
Each answerable case names supporting document/chunk evidence; labels and limitations are reviewed.
Held-out cases are not used for tuning; an independent reviewer/author is preferable, not claimed if absent.
units.flex_task: The evidence note is scheduled weekly in the daily schedule, not charged twice to this unit.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Non-neural retrieval baseline
units.primary_task: Implement SQLite FTS/BM25 or another documented keyword baseline over the same chunks; run retrieval evaluation on development answerable questions.
acceptance_criteria: Results expose source/chunk IDs and ranking, not fabricated citations.
Recall@k and/or MRR use the correct answerable-case denominator and declared evidence mapping.
Save all development results, including misses; no held-out tuning.
units.flex_task: Repair baseline or labels; do not add hybrid/reranking before measuring the baseline.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: A genuine persisted vector database
units.primary_task: Create a real persisted vector collection using Qdrant local mode or another current supported vector database; upsert chunk vectors/metadata and perform actual nearest-neighbor queries.
acceptance_criteria: Restarting the process preserves the intended collection/data.
Upsert/version handling and the configured distance metric match the embedding contract.
A real vector-store call returns meaningful chunk IDs; an in-memory mock or NumPy-only search does not pass this gate.
units.flex_task: Resolve actual DB/model integration problems; server/container mode can wait until P2.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Retrieval comparison and inspection
units.primary_task: Expose a /retrieve path; evaluate keyword versus vector retrieval on the same development set; inspect misses and make one evidence-based choice.
acceptance_criteria: Declare k, model/config, metric definitions and actual sample counts.
Do not compare unlike raw score scales as if calibrated.
Explain one retrieval miss and one next experiment; an improvement is measured, not guaranteed.
units.flex_task: Study precision/recall/ranking and small-sample limitations using these actual results.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Grounding prompt and trustworthy source plumbing
units.primary_task: Build a context envelope that separates instructions from untrusted retrieved text; require answers to cite supplied source IDs, and validate all cited IDs against retrieved evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Only supplied source IDs can appear as valid citations.
No secret or unrelated private context is placed in the prompt.
Explain that ID validity alone does not prove that a cited passage supports a claim.
units.flex_task: Debug prompt/context limits and citation plumbing; do not hide unsupported claims.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: First genuine generative RAG path
units.primary_task: Connect question → real retrieval → actual generative model → validated answer/citations; render source snippets from the original corpus in the UI.
acceptance_criteria: A real user query retrieves actual stored vectors and produces a new model-generated answer grounded in returned text.
Displayed snippets come from corpus storage, not a model-invented URL or quote.
Save one successful and one failing real trace, including retrieval and generation stages.
units.flex_task: Repair end-to-end wiring; this gate cannot be replaced by extractive/template output.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Abstention and user-facing limits
units.primary_task: Implement an explicit insufficient-evidence/clarification path and evaluate it on development unanswerable cases; distinguish retrieval weakness from answer-generation weakness.
acceptance_criteria: Missing evidence does not force a confident answer.
Tests cover empty retrieval and unsupported requested claims.
Any score threshold is documented as a heuristic, not proof; manually review actual generated claims against evidence.
units.flex_task: Review calibration/uncertainty and why model confidence is not a truth score.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Failure taxonomy and traces
units.primary_task: Run the development evaluation and classify failures as retrieval, unsupported generation, wrong citation, schema, latency or operational failure; connect the stages using trace IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Every scored case has a result and failure/review reason, not only a summary percentage.
Trace includes model/config and stage timing; sensitive content is not logged by default.
Select one next repair based on observed failures; do not tune on held-out data.
units.flex_task: The evidence note is scheduled weekly in the daily schedule, not charged twice to this unit.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Input, data and secret boundaries
units.primary_task: Keep the prototype local-only/single-user; enforce allowed file types, size/path bounds and safe rendering; add secret/data-handling checks and a short threat model.
acceptance_criteria: Untrusted filenames/path traversal and oversized/invalid inputs are rejected.
Model output is not executed or rendered as unsafe HTML.
State that authentication, multi-tenancy and public exposure are not yet established; no production-security claim.
units.flex_task: Study actual trust boundaries and least privilege for the planned next phase.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Adversarial documents and regression tests
units.primary_task: Add controlled malicious-document instructions and misleading evidence cases; verify deterministic access boundaries, inspect model behavior and turn observed defects into regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieved text cannot authorize tools, filesystem access or external actions; this prototype has no such tool permission.
No credentials or hidden real secrets exist in model context; use synthetic canaries for tests.
Record any prompt-following/unsupported-answer failures honestly; passing a few cases is not universal injection resistance.
units.flex_task: Read current official guidance for the chosen runtime/SDK and explain prompt-level versus enforced controls.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Reproducible build and CI boundary
units.primary_task: Add one clean setup/test command, CI for deterministic tests, and a container build/smoke test for the API; document the host model runtime and persisted local vector data.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh environment runs offline tests without real-provider credentials.
The API container starts and passes its stated health smoke test.
Separate this limited container check from the real local RAG receipt; it is not a cloud or full production deployment.
units.flex_task: Fix reproducibility defects; full hosted/container orchestration belongs in P2.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Bounded failure and recovery behavior
units.primary_task: Test provider unavailable, slow response, malformed response and canceled request paths; cap retries/deadlines and prevent accidental duplicate work where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Every failure terminates within a declared budget or is explicitly reported as a defect.
No unbounded retry loop; user-visible state and trace show failure/cancellation.
At least one actual runtime outage/recovery is observed; simulated failures are labeled test injections.
units.flex_task: Repair the most important reliability failure; do not add a queue solely for architecture appearance.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Honest latency and resource baseline
units.primary_task: Run a small reproducible local benchmark (for example 12 requests with declared concurrency); record retrieval/generation/end-to-end latency, model settings and machine resource limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Report actual sample size, concurrency, warm/cold conditions and latency values.
Cost/token fields are actual or explicitly unavailable; no invented cloud/API estimate is presented as measured.
Explain one quality/latency/resource tradeoff and the limits of this small local test.
units.flex_task: Resolve benchmark defects; optimize only if measured evidence justifies it.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Discovery, scope change and handoff draft
units.primary_task: Revisit the problem brief in a short stakeholder role-play or authorized peer review; ask data/access/value questions, identify one useful scoped change and draft a runbook/handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Label role-play, peer feedback and actual user feedback accurately.
State baseline, proposed success measure, non-goals, data restrictions and go/no-go limits.
No invented business savings/customer adoption; one tradeoff is explained to a nontechnical audience.
units.flex_task: Repair scope or documentation gaps; external outreach is not automatically authorized.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Independent ownership check
units.primary_task: Without receiving a finished solution, trace a question end-to-end and implement one small reviewer-selected change or diagnose an injected defect; add a regression test.
acceptance_criteria: Explain retrieval, context, generation, citation validation and failure handling in your own words.
The attempt shows learner-owned reasoning/code, not a replay of supplied solution text.
Record help used and unresolved gaps; a failed check becomes remediation rather than a completion badge.
units.flex_task: The evidence note is scheduled weekly in the daily schedule, not charged twice to this unit.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Held-out check and acceptance audit
units.primary_task: Freeze the current configuration, run the ten held-out cases once for this release, score against the rubric and audit mandatory capability/security evidence.
acceptance_criteria: For this narrow prototype, proposed release target: at least 5/6 answerable cases correct and supported, 2/2 unanswerable cases not fabricated, and no deterministic access-boundary failure; report exact counts and adversarial behavior.
All citations resolve; unsupported-claim failures are visible. The tiny dataset does not establish enterprise safety/quality.
A failed gate remains failed; remediate on development cases and use a fresh held-out release set later rather than tuning the same test cases.
units.flex_task: Fix non-model test/audit defects or schedule failed-quality remediation; do not silently lower thresholds.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.

units.title: Clean-run demo and honest first checkpoint
units.primary_task: Run setup/tests from a clean environment/profile; perform a real RAG smoke request and a five-minute demo with source evidence plus a failure/abstention path; finalize the concise case-study draft.
acceptance_criteria: Another person can follow the instructions where available; otherwise label the verification self-run.
All required real capabilities have receipts, or P1 remains blocked/incomplete with exact gaps.
Clearly call this a local single-user prototype; cloud deployment, real-customer production and certification are not claimed.
units.flex_task: Close reproducibility/ownership gaps; do not advance solely because Day 30 arrived.
units.completion_rule: Pass prerequisite and acceptance evidence; elapsed date, generated scaffold, mock-only test, or assistant completion does not establish learner completion.
